origin.reference: operator directive 2026-09-06: one executable, region-directed template whose parameters actually change with the detected region

rationale: RESAMPLE_REGION made executable. A detector (D3 LOCAL_VARIANCE_ANOMALY, D5 REPEATED_OUTLIER_REGION) fires on a WORLD; that world's landscape is fixed by worlds.seed_root and work.payload.length, both read from the ledger. This template re-runs evaluate_bitstring on the SAME landscape (seed_root and length taken from the fired region, never drawn) with a fresh uniformly random candidate. The dispersion a variance anomaly asks about needs n on the same landscape; this is n. Drawable only with region context: without a fired region the draw refuses rather than becoming a random draw wearing a directed label. Policy menu.region_directed.v0; the random baseline bitstring.uniform.v0 is untouched. Whether directing improves selection is M-SIGNAL and Harmonia's to judge; this template is the intervention M-SIGNAL needs to exist.
